summary: Dual block mount with two 8 mm cubic end blocks joined by a thinner flat bar. The bar carries three evenly spaced counterbored holes. Each block has tapped holes on three faces. The part is roughly an elongated U or bridge shape.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top face of the end blocks and bar, flush and carrying the end-block holes and the three bar holes
Outer end faces of the two blocks, each with a hole on the block axis
Side faces of the blocks, each with a hole on the block axis

notes: No dimensions were provided, so all sizes are assumptions. The part sits on the 8 mm goBILDA grid. The '1-5' name is read as five hole positions counted inclusive, two at the block centers and three bar holes between them. That gives 32 mm center-to-center spacing, so x = 32 + 8 = 40 mm. The end blocks are assumed to be 8 mm cubes, so y and z are both 8 mm. The bar looks about half the block height, which is not modeled here. The bar-hole diameter of about 5 mm and the block-hole diameter of about 4 mm are rough estimates from the photos. The 5.7 g aluminum weight is roughly consistent with these volumes but does not confirm them. Block hole positions are given at block centers, and the hole depths are not known.
